questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhōngguó méitàn zīyuán bù shǎo, chǎnliàng hěn gāo.

answers.answer_text: China's coal resources are large and output is high.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Shì, xiànzài Zhōngguó méitàn chǎnliàng zài shìjièshang zhàn dìsānwèi.

answers.answer_text: Yes, China's coal output ranks third in the world.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Cóngqián Zhōngguóde shíyóu dàbùfen zài lí biānjìng bù yuǎnde dìfang.

answers.answer_text: In the past, China's oil was mostly in places out near the border.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Xiànzài yánhǎi yídàide shíyóu yě fāzhǎnqilai le.

answers.answer_text: Now oil in the coastal region is starting to be developed.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhèige kuàngqūde jīnshǔ gōngyè shi shénme shíhou kāishǐ yǒude?

answers.answer_text: When did the metal industry in this mining area begin?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Bāshí niándài. Jīxiè gōngyè yě shi bāshí niándài cái yǒude.

answers.answer_text: In the eighties. There wasn't a machine industry until the eighties, either.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zài guò shínián, dào jiǔshí niándài chū, zhèige guójiā dàgài huì biànchéng yíge jīngjì qiángguó.

answers.answer_text: In another ten years, in the early nineties, this country will probably become an economic power.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Bù xíng, qǐmǎ děi zài guò èrshinián.

answers.answer_text: No, it will be at least another twenty years.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhèiwèi zài guówài yǒu míngde gōngchéngshī, huí guó yǐhòu zěnmeyàng la?

answers.answer_text: What happened when this engineer who was famous abroad went back to his country?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Huí guó yǐhòu yìzhí gǎo zhòng gōngyè fāngmiànde jìshù gōngzuò.

answers.answer_text: He has been doing technical work in heavy industry since he returned to his country.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Bù jiù shi Rìběn, xiànzài gèguó dōu hěn guānxīn Zhōngguó yánhǎide jīngjì jiànshè.

answers.answer_text: Not only Japan, all countries are now interested in the economic construction of China's coast.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Shì. Yǐjing yǒu xǔduō guójiā xiǎng hé Zhōngguó yìqǐ zài nèi yídài chénglì xīnde gōngsī.

answers.answer_text: Yes, there are already many countries which are thinking of establishing new companies with China in that area.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Tīngshuō zhèige nóngyèqū yǐjing yǒu lìliang fāzhǎn gōngyè le.

answers.answer_text: I hear that this agricultural area already has the capability to develop its industry.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Jìn shínián lái, zhèige dìqūde nóngyè shēngchǎn gǎode bú cuò, shōurù bù shǎo, gǎole yìdiǎnr qīng gōngyè.

answers.answer_text: Over the past ten years, agricultural production in this area has been good and income has been high, so some light industry was set up.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Tīngshuō èrshinián qián yǒu hěn duō niánqīng rén dàole nèige méiyou rénde qióng dìfang.

answers.answer_text: I heard that twenty years ago a lot of young people came to that poor and unpopulated place.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Shì a! Kěshi xiànzài zhèngfǔ kěyi fàng xīn le. Nèige dìfang yǐjing suàn jiànshède bú cuò le.

answers.answer_text: Yes, but now the government need not worry anymore. That place can be considered to have been pretty well built up.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zǒngde lái shuō ba, zhèige chéngshìde biànhuà shi hěn dàde.

answers.answer_text: Generally speaking, the changes in this city have been great.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Shì a, zhàn zài shì zhōngxīnde dàlóushang kànkan, wǒ dōu bú rènshi le!

answers.answer_text: Yes, standing on top of the building in the center of the city, looking out, I don't recognize anything anymore!

questions_and_answers.question_text: Xǔduō jīngjì lìliang bǐjiào ruòde guójiā hěn gǎnxiè Zhōngguóde bāngzhù.

answers.answer_text: Many countries with relatively weak economies are grateful for China's help.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wǒmen yě shi yíge fāzhǎnzhōngde guójiā, kěshi wǒmen hěn gāoxìng bāng qítā guójiā gǎo jīngjì jiànshè.

answers.answer_text: We're still a developing country, too, but we're happy to help other countries in economic construction.
